title: Import Users result: a deactivated pending person's row reads 'Already pending, told again: true' next to 'Why not told: deactivated'
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYRqkDAGuse5Wqbohi

Filing gate ① (product defect, named producer). Out-of-scope finding from the os-dev report 6973807530 on #34651 (PR #35162). Dedupe: `is:issue "told again" deactivated` → 1 hit (#34651, the source); `is:issue "Already pending, told again"` → same; `is:issue import_sso_users alreadyPending label` → 3 hits (#34651, #33187, #33186 closed), none on this label.

## Defect

`sys_user.import_sso_users`'s result labels its `alreadyPending` table column and `summary.alreadyPending` field "Already pending, told again" (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`). But `addOnePendingPerson` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts` answers `alreadyPending: true` with `host: { notified: false, reason: 'deactivated' }` for a pending person who is deactivated (pinned in `pending-sso-users.test.ts`, describe `[#33228]`, "re-adding a deactivated pending person does not invite them"). On that row the Import Users result draws "Already pending, told again: true" beside "Why not told: deactivated": the label says the person was told, the next column says they were not.

reach: named real producer (the door and the object's result labels above, read from code and the existing pin).

## Fix direction

Label the column for what `alreadyPending` means ("Already pending"), as PR #35162 did for the Add User field, leaving "told" to the host columns; translations in the platform-objects bundles.

## Why it matters

An admin importing people on a managed environment reads a contradiction for a deactivated pending person and cannot tell whether an invitation went out.

## Reader

The lane holding `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` (`domain:server`), when p3 work resumes; or the next PR touching `sys_user.import_sso_users`'s result labels.

Grading: p3 · who: an admin importing a CSV that re-adds a deactivated pending person · door: Import Users result dialog · frequency: rare configuration (a deactivated pending person) · read from code. User-visible wrong text (p2) lowered one tier for the rare configuration.
